acceptance_checks.then: the build SHALL exit 0 with no missing-layout or missing-include error in its log
acceptance_checks.verify_method: gate: `jekyll build` exits 0; build log contains no "Could not find layout" or "Included file not found"

acceptance_checks.given: favicon and social-card image references in the built output
acceptance_checks.when: `_site` is scanned for local image paths
acceptance_checks.then: every referenced local image SHALL resolve to a file that exists, never a dangling path such as bottle.png or me.jpg
acceptance_checks.verify_method: script asserts each local image reference in `_site` exists on disk; zero missing

acceptance_checks.given: a post carrying a per-post summary field
acceptance_checks.when: the page is built with jekyll-seo-tag enabled
acceptance_checks.then: the emitted meta description SHALL be that post's own summary rather than the generic site description
acceptance_checks.verify_method: for a sample post, the `_site` meta description equals the post summary text, not `site.description`

acceptance_checks.then: the site SHALL publish a syndication feed whose entries contain the full post body rather than a truncated excerpt
acceptance_checks.verify_method: the first `feed.xml` entry content length is within 5% of the rendered post body length

acceptance_checks.then: the site chrome SHALL surface a human-visible link to the feed in the header or footer, not only a `<link rel>` hint
acceptance_checks.verify_method: an `<a>` whose href resolves to the feed appears in the rendered header or footer markup

acceptance_checks.when: the built site is scanned for analytics identifiers
acceptance_checks.then: no `UA-` Universal Analytics identifier SHALL remain in any emitted page
the build SHALL emit a `sitemap.xml` listing the published pages of the site
acceptance_checks.verify_method: `_site/sitemap.xml` exists and lists at least the home, About, Notebook, plus each post URL

acceptance_checks.then: every rendered page SHALL carry a canonical URL whose host is the served `hlavezzo.me` origin

acceptance_checks.when: it is scanned for Font Awesome stylesheet references
acceptance_checks.then: exactly one Font Awesome version SHALL be loaded
acceptance_checks.verify_method: `grep -rho "font-awesome[^\"']*" _site | sort -u` yields exactly one version string

acceptance_checks.given: the post front matter across the corpus
acceptance_checks.when: it is scanned for comment-system fields
acceptance_checks.then: no post SHALL declare a `comments` field while no comment system is wired

every programming language advertised in the keywords SHALL be a member of the language set backed by the skills data
